name: Claude Channel Feishu
description: This plugin connects Feishu (Lark) IM to Claude Code as a messaging channel. It runs an MCP server with tools such as reply, react, pair, attachment download, and message edit, while a WebSocket long connection subscribes to im.message.receive_v1 so inbound bot messages are delivered into the active session as channel events. Built-in access control covers DM pairing, allowlists, opt-in group chats by chat_id, @-bot detection, and optional keyword substring matching. State and policy live under ~/.claude/channels/feishu/ (overridable via FEISHU_STATE_DIR). It suits teams and individuals who want Feishu as a front door to a Claude Code session with explicit trust boundaries.
longDescription:
Ships **2 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (2): `access` (管理飞书 Channel 访问控制 — 批准配对、维护白名单、设置私聊/群策略。当用户要配对、批准某人、查看谁被允许、或修改飞书 channel 策略时触发。), `configure` (配置飞书 Channel — 写入 App ID / App Secret 并说明访问策略。当用户粘贴飞书凭证、问「怎么配」「谁能连到我」、或要查看 channel 状态时触发。)
- **MCP servers** (1): `feishu`

Installs with `claude plugin install claude-channel-feishu@claude-community` from `chenxingyuu/claude-channel-feishu`.
